LanguageData.DMS_Occultech_ExemptText:
Our researchers have decoded {0}.

{1} holds the rank of {2} on the {3} service roll, and has filed a temporary release order against the classification on the grounds of emergency necessity. The file is logged as an authorized wartime exception rather than an unauthorized decryption.

No sanction follows. The order stands only as long as an officer of that rank remains with us.
LanguageData.DMS_Occultech_RestrictedText:
We have decoded {0}, a restricted-class file. Technology at this classification is withheld for environmental and ethical reasons, or for the permanent changes it works on the people who use it, not because it is dangerous to anyone else.

{1} has logged the decryption against our name. Goodwill {3} → {4} ({2}).

Had a colonist of {5} rank or above been with us, they could have signed a temporary release order and the matter would have ended there.
LanguageData.DMS_Occultech_SealedText:
We have opened {0}, a sealed-class file. Technology at this classification is withheld because its spread starts arms races across star systems. Inside the fleets the contents are common knowledge: line personnel are taught to recognize the signature and report it. Outside them, holding it is cause enough.

{1} has recognized the signature and declared us hostile.

While we keep any sealed technology, they will go no further than a truce: the relationship cannot return to alliance until we formally renounce the file over the comms console. A colonist of {2} rank or above could have carried it without any of this.
LanguageData.DMS_Occultech_OccultedText:
We have opened {0}, an occulted-class file. Knowing that technology of this class exists is itself the hazard: every seal that fails is another chance for hundreds of millions of people to be spent on someone's private ambition.

{1} has declared a standing kill order against this colony. There is no release order, no rank and no argument that lifts it. Their hunting elements will keep coming.

Word has gone out along their lines. {2} have broken off with us as well; those ties, at least, can be repaired in time.

One road out remains. Submit our highest-ranking officer to a fleet court-martial and let them serve a full year, and the kill order ends. At neutral, never better.
LanguageData.DMS_Occultech_AllyBlockedMessage: {0} will not ally with us while we hold sealed technology.
LanguageData.DMS_Occultech_PardonText: The sentence has been served in full. {0} has rescinded its standing kill order against this colony and restored us to neutral standing.\n\nThe file we opened is still open. They have simply stopped sending people to close it.
LanguageData.DMS_Occultech_RenounceBlockedPermanent: They are not taking our calls on this. Only a court-martial ends a kill order.
LanguageData.DMS_Occultech_RenounceConfirm:
You open a channel to the {0} records office and offer to surrender everything we hold under seal.

The following research will be reset to zero and everything it unlocks will be locked again:

{1}

This cannot be undone: the work would have to be redone from nothing. In exchange, {0} will consider an alliance with us again.
